executive_brief: The Expense Tracker CLI is a command-line interface application designed for managing personal finances. It provides core operations for adding, listing, and deleting expense records with strict validation on amounts, categories, and date formats. The system operates on a structured entity model enforcing specific business rules for data integrity.

architectural_constraints: Category restricted to enum: Food, Transport, Bills, Utilities
Description defaults to empty string if omitted
Error mapping: ValidationError returns specific message, EntityNotFoundError returns not found message, DatabaseLockedError returns busy message, UnexpectedError returns generic message
List output format: Tabular ID | Date | Category | Amount | Description with Total sum
Empty state displays: No expenses found for the selected criteria. Total: 0.00

maturity_assessment: The specification demonstrates high structural completeness with a health index of 95 and full coverage of core business flows. One structural gap identified in the 'Tech Stack & Tooling' section indicates the programming language and frameworks require explicit documentation. All critical command schemas (add, list, delete) are fully defined with validation rules and error handling. The project is assessed as READY for execution with minor refinement needed for tooling documentation.
critical_dependencies: CATEGORY-ENUM dependency for expense creation validation
DATE-FORMAT dependency for expense creation and filtering
EXPENSE-ENTITY structural dependence for add, list, and delete operations
Error Handling Rules mapping service exceptions to CLI output messages
Database access dependency for create, read, update, and delete operations
